connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

cpu.title: CPU (vCPU)
cpu.description: Notebook (singleuser) pod CPU guarantee in vCPU. The limit is twice the guarantee.

memoryGi.title: Memory (GiB)
memoryGi.description: Notebook (singleuser) pod memory guarantee in GiB. The limit is twice the guarantee.

welcomeNotebook.title: Welcome notebook
welcomeNotebook.description: Welcome.ipynb content copied into each user home.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: Connection to the S3-compatible object store backing the jupyter-fs file browser.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: Secret with keys accessKey/secretKey, this instance's own S3 identity.

fileBrowserLocations.title: File browser locations
fileBrowserLocations.description: jupyter-fs file browser locations (display name + s3 uri).

oidcRoleMapping.title: Role mapping
oidcRoleMapping.description: Optional GenericOAuthenticator overrides (claim_groups_key, allowed_groups, admin_groups, ...). Without allowed_groups the hub answers 403 to everyone.

pyspark.title: Enabled connections
pyspark.description: Names of the Spark connections below to wire into the PySpark kernel. Empty leaves the kernel without S3A or catalog settings.

sparkConnections.title: Connections
sparkConnections.description: PySpark connections: final spark conf lines (one per line) and optionally their own S3 identity (Secret with accessKey/secretKey, referenced as $(S3_ACCESS_KEY)/$(S3_SECRET_KEY)).

sparkDefaults.title: Conf defaults
sparkDefaults.description: Spark conf defaults injected into PYSPARK_SUBMIT_ARGS (final values).

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream charts this chart renders, one object per chart, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

jupyterhub.title: jupyterhub
jupyterhub.description: Values of the jupyterhub chart 4.4.2 (https://hub.jupyter.org/helm-chart/), for example hub.image, hub.resources, hub.extraConfig, hub.config (Authenticator, GenericOAuthenticator role mapping), singleuser.image, singleuser.extraEnv, singleuser.nodeSelector, scheduling, culling. Refused: fullnameOverride, nameOverride, hub.config.ConfigurableHTTPProxy, hub.config.CryptKeeper, hub.config.JupyterHub.cookie_secret/hub_connect_url/authenticator_class, hub.config.Authenticator.enable_auth_state, hub.config.GenericOAuthenticator.client_id/client_secret/oauth_callback_url/authorize_url/token_url/userdata_url, hub.extraEnv.OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET/JUPYTERHUB_CRYPT_KEY, hub.existingSecret, hub.cookieSecret, hub.services, proxy.secretToken, ingress.enabled/ingressClassName/hosts/tls, prePuller.hook.enabled, singleuser.podNameTemplate, singleuser.serviceAccountName, singleuser.storage.dynamic.pvcNameTemplate/volumeNameTemplate, singleuser.extraEnv FS_S3_ENDPOINT_URL/FS_S3_ACCESS_KEY/FS_S3_SECRET_KEY/POD_IP, the <PREFIX>_S3_ACCESS_KEY/<PREFIX>_S3_SECRET_KEY of the pyspark connections and the platform proxy variables, singleuser.extraFiles jupyter_server_config_py/notebook_oauth2/welcome-notebook. Appended to the lists this chart sets: hub.config.JupyterHub.load_roles, singleuser.storage.extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts, singleuser.profileList.

spark-rbac.title: spark-rbac
spark-rbac.description: Values of the spark-rbac chart 1.0.1 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts), the spark ServiceAccount and Role of the notebooks: serviceAccount.annotations (workload identity), serviceAccount.automount, rbac.annotations. Refused: rbac.create, serviceAccount.create, serviceAccount.name.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
